title: 저수지ㆍ댐의 안전관리 및 재해예방에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.text_en: Ministry of the Interior and Safety ( Disaster Mitigation Division ), 044-205-5147

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「저수지ㆍ댐의 안전관리 및 재해예방에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Safety Management of Reservoirs and Dams and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(재해위험 저수지ㆍ댐의 지정 보고) 「저수지ㆍ댐의 안전관리 및 재해예방에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제9조제2항 및 제3항에 따라 「저수지ㆍ댐의 안전관리 및 재해예방에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제9조제1항에 따른 재해위험 저수지ㆍ댐(이하 “위험저수지ㆍ댐”이라 한다)을 지정하거나 지정을 해제하였을 때 행정안전부장관 및 관계 중앙행정기관의 장에 대한 보고는 별지 제1호서식에 따른다. <개정 2014. 11. 19., 2017. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Reporting on Designation of Reservoirs and Dams at Risk of Disaster) In accordance with Article 9, Paragraphs 2 and 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Safety Management of Reservoirs and Dams and Prevention of Disasters (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), when(hereinafter referred to as “risky reservoir or dam”) is designated or its designation is revoked pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Act on Safety Management of Reservoirs and Dams and Prevention of Disasters (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the report to the Minister of the Interior and Safety and the heads of relevant central administrative agencies shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 of the Attached Form . <Amended Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(위탁관리자 결정서) 영 제11조제1항에 따른 위탁관리자 결정서는 별지 제2호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Decision on Entrusted Manager) The decision on the entrusted manager pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 2 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제4조(위험저수지ㆍ댐 정비지구 지정 신청 등) ① 법 제10조제1항에 따른 위탁시행자(이하 “위탁시행자”라 한다)가 법 제12조제3항에 따라 위험저수지ㆍ댐 정비지구의 지정을 신청할 때에는 별지 제3호서식의 위험저수지ㆍ댐 정비지구 지정신청서에 법 제12조제2항 각 호의 내용이 포함된 정비기본계획을 첨부하여 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Application for Designation of Hazardous Reservoir/Dam Improvement District, etc.) ①When an entrusted implementing entity pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “entrusted implementing entity”) applies for the designation of a hazardous reservoir/dam improvement district pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 3 of the Act , it shall submit an application for designation of a hazardous reservoir/dam improvement district in the form of Annex 3 , attaching a basic improvement plan that includes the contents of each subparagraph of Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: ② 특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수 또는 자치구의 구청장(이하 “시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장”이라 한다)이 영 제14조에 따라 위험저수지ㆍ댐 정비지구를 지정ㆍ고시할 때에는 특별자치도ㆍ시ㆍ군ㆍ구에서 발행하는 공보에 다음 각 호의 사항을 게재하는 방법으로 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, Mayor, County Governor, or Head of a Self-Governing District (hereinafter referred to as “Mayor, County Governor, or Head of District”) designates and notifies a hazardous reservoir or dam maintenance district pursuant to Article 14 of the Enforcement Decree , they shall do so by publishing the matters of each of the following subparagraphs in the official gazette issued by the Special Self-Governing Province, City, County, or District.
1. Name of the redevelopment district
2. Purpose and Overview of Redevelopment District Designation
3. Designated Location and Area of ​​the Redevelopment District

rows.source_ko: 4. 위탁시행자의 명칭 및 소재지와 그 대표자의 성명 및 주소
rows.text_en: 4. Name and location of the entrusted implementer and name and address of its representative
5. Key Contents of the Basic Maintenance Plan

rows.source_ko: 6. 정비기본계획에 편입되는 토지의 세목(細目)에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the detailed items of land incorporated into the basic maintenance plan
7. Topographic map pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 2 of the Framework Act on Land Use Regulation

rows.source_ko: 제5조(정비사업시행계획의 승인 고시) 광역시장ㆍ도지사ㆍ특별자치도지사(이하 “시ㆍ도지사”라 한다)는 영 제18조제4항에 따라 정비사업시행계획의 승인을 고시할 때에는 해당 광역시ㆍ도ㆍ특별자치도(이하 “시ㆍ도”라 한다)에서 발행하는 공보에 다음 각 호의 사항을 게재하는 방법으로 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Notice of Approval of Redevelopment Project Implementation Plan) When a Mayor of a Metropolitan City, a Governor of a Province, or a Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as “City/Province Governor”) gives notice of approval of a redevelopment project implementation plan pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree, they shall do so by publishing the matters of each of the following subparagraphs in the official gazette issued by the relevant Metropolitan City, Province, or Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as “City/Province”).
1. Matters under each subparagraph of Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: 2. 수용하거나 사용할 다음 각 목의 물건 또는 권리에 관한 명세와 그 소유자 또는 소유자 외의 권리자의 성명 및 주소
rows.text_en: 2. Details regarding the items or rights listed in each of the following subparagraphs to be expropriated or used, and the name and address of the owner or rights holder other than the owner.

rows.source_ko: 가. 토지나 토지 소유권 외의 권리
rows.text_en: a. Rights other than land or land ownership

rows.source_ko: 나. 토지에 정착한 물건이나 그 물건에 관한 소유권 외의 권리
rows.text_en: B. Objects fixed to the land or rights other than ownership relating to such objects

rows.source_ko: 제6조(정비사업추진상황 등의 보고) ① 정비사업시행자는 법 제14조제1항에 따라 정비사업에 착수하였을 때에는 별지 제4호서식의 착공계에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Reporting on Progress of Redevelopment Project, etc.) ① When a redevelopment project implementerhas commenced a redevelopment project pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 1 of the Act , they shall submit a notice of commencement of work in the form of Annex 4, along with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head.
1. Scheduled Schedule
2. Plan for Appointing a Responsible Engineer
3. Detailed Works Survey

rows.source_ko: ② 정비사업시행자는 법 제14조제2항에 따라 사업추진상황을 보고할 때에는 별지 제5호서식에 따른 사업추진상황 보고서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 분기별로 1회 이상 시ㆍ도지사 및 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When reporting on the progress of a project pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the project implementer shall submit a report on the progress of a project in accordance with Form No. 5 attached with the following documents to the mayor, county head, or district head at least once every quarter.
1. Detailed Project Implementation Plans by Construction Type
2. Photos of Major Construction Status

rows.source_ko: ③ 시ㆍ도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제14조제3항에 따라 해당 사업장을 점검한 결과 다음 각 호에 해당하는 사유가 발견되면 시정조치를 명하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ If the mayor, county governor, or district head discovers any of the following reasons as a result of inspecting the relevant workplace pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 3 of the Act, they shall order corrective measures.
1. In the case of poor construction and quality control
2. Cases where the project is not carried out in accordance with the maintenance project implementation plan

rows.source_ko: 3. 위험저수지ㆍ댐의 재해예방대책이 부실하게 이루어지고 있는 경우
rows.text_en: 3. Cases where disaster prevention measures for hazardous reservoirs and dams are being inadequately implemented

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 정비사업 시행 과정에서 개선ㆍ보완이 필요하다고 인정되는 사항이 발생한 경우
rows.text_en: 4. Any other cases where matters deemed necessary for improvement or supplementation arise during the implementation of the maintenance project

rows.source_ko: ④ 시ㆍ도지사가 법 제14조제5항에 따라 사업시행계획의 승인을 취소 할 때에는 해당 시ㆍ도에서 발행하는 공보에 취소 사실을 게재하는 방법으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ When a mayor or provincial governor cancels the approval of a project implementation plan pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 5 of the Act , the cancellation shall be done by publishing the fact of cancellation in the official gazette issued by the relevant mayor or provincial government.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(준공검사 및 사업완료 공고) ① 정비사업시행자는 정비사업을 완료하였을 때에는 별지 제6호서식의 준공계에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Completion Inspection and Public Notice of Project Completion) ① When a maintenance project implementer has completed a maintenance project, they shall submit a completion report in the form of Annex 6 to the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head, attaching the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs.
1. Completion report (including completion photos)
2. As-built design documents
3. Documents regarding the management and disposal of public facilities

rows.source_ko: 4. 관계 행정기관의 장과의 협의에 필요한 서류
rows.text_en: 4. Documents required for consultation with the heads of relevant administrative agencies

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제19조제2항에 따른 준공검사필증은 별지 제7호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The certificate of completion inspection pursuant to Article 19 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 7 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 시ㆍ도지사가 영 제19조제2항에 따라 사업완료를 공고할 때에는 해당 시ㆍ도에서 발행하는 공보에 다음 각 호의 사항을 게재하는 방법으로 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When a Mayor or Provincial Governor announces the completion of a project pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree , they shall do so by publishing the following matters in the official gazette issued by the relevant Mayor or Provincial.
1. Name of the redevelopment project

rows.source_ko: 2. 정비사업시행자의 명칭 및 소재지와 그 대표자의 성명 및 주소
rows.text_en: 2. Name and location of the redevelopment project implementer and name and address of its representative
3. Location of the redevelopment project area
4. Area or scale of the redevelopment project
5. Details of Major Maintenance Projects

rows.source_ko: 6. 정비사업의 착수 연월일 및 준공 연월일
rows.text_en: 6. Date of commencement and date of completion of the maintenance project

rows.source_ko: 제8조(행위 제한 신고) 정비지구를 지정ㆍ고시하기 전에 허가를 받아 정비지구에서 공사나 사업을 착수한 자가 법 제17조 단서에 따라 그 공사나 사업을 계속 시행하기 위해서는 해당 허가서를 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Reporting of Restriction on Activities) In order to continue carrying out construction or business in a redevelopment district after obtaining permission prior to the designation and public announcement of the redevelopment district, a person who has commenced such construction or business shall submit the relevant permission document to the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head.

rows.source_ko: 제9조(수료증 등) ① 영 제24조제3항에 따라 교육기관의 장이 발급하는 수료증은 별지 제8호서식에 따르고, 수료증 발급대장은 별지 제9호서식에 따라 작성ㆍ관리하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Certificate of Completion, etc.) ①A certificate of completion issued by the head of an educational institution pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 8 of the Attached Form , and a register of certificates of completionshall be prepared and managed in accordance with Form No. 9 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 교육기관의 장이 영 제24조제4항에 따라 그 해의 교육 실적을 제출할 때에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the head of an educational institution submits the educational performance results for the year in accordance with Article 24, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree , the following matters must be included:
1. Annual Training Completion Status

rows.source_ko: 2. 회차별 교육 일정, 교과목 편성 내용, 교육시간표 및 강사진 현황
rows.text_en: 2. Training Schedule by Session, Curriculum Content, Training Timetable, and Instructor Status
ADDENDA <Ministry of Public Administration and Security Decree No. 88, June 5, 2009>
This rule shall take effect on June 6, 2009.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <총리령 제1105호, 2014. 11. 19.> (국민안전처와 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Prime Minister's Decree No. 1105, Nov. 19, 2014> (Enforcement Rule for the Organization of the Ministry of Public Safety and Security and Its Affiliated Agencies)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 부칙 제6조에 따라 개정되는 부령 중 이 규칙 시행 전에 공포되었으나 시행일이 도래하지 아니한 총리령 또는 부령을 개정한 부분은 각각 해당 총리령 또는 부령의 시행일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, among the Ministerial Ordinances amended pursuant to Article 6 of the Addenda, the parts amending Prime Ministerial Ordinances or Ministerial Ordinances that were promulgated prior to the enforcement of this Rule but whose effective date has not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective effective dates of the said Prime Ministerial Ordinances or Ministerial Ordinances.
Articles 2  through 5 omitted

rows.source_ko: 제6조(다른 법령의 개정) ①부터 ㉙까지 생략
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① through ㉙ omitted

rows.source_ko: ㉚ 저수지ㆍ댐의 안전관리 및 재해예방에 관한 법률 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: 30 The Enforcement Rules of the Act on Safety Management and Disaster Prevention of Reservoirs and Dams are partially amended as follows.
In Article 2, “Commissioner of the National Fire Agency” shall be changed to “Minister of Public Safety and Security”.

rows.source_ko: 별지 제3호서식 뒤쪽 중 “시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(시ㆍ도지사, 소방방재청장)”을 “시ㆍ군ㆍ구(시ㆍ도, 국민안전처)”로, “소방방재청”을 각각 “국민안전처”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the back of Form No. 3, “Mayor/County Head/District Head (City/Provincial Governor, Commissioner of National Fire Agency)” shall be changed to “City/County/District (City/Province, Ministry of Public Safety and Security)”, and “National Fire Agency” shall be changed to “Ministry of Public Safety and Security”.
omitted from 31 to 46

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <총리령 제1247호, 2016. 1. 27.> (법령서식 일괄 개정을 위한 119구조ㆍ구급에 관한 법률 시행규칙 등 일부개정령)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Prime Minister's Decree No. 1247, Jan. 27, 2016> (Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules of the Act on 119 Rescue and Emergency Medical Services, etc. for the Batch Amendment of Legal Forms)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(서식에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 당시 종전의 규정에 따른 서식은 이 규칙 시행 이후 3개월 간 이 규칙에 따른 서식과 함께 사용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Regarding Forms)  Forms under the previous regulations at the time of enforcement of this rule may be used together with the forms under this rule for three months after enforcement of this rule.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <행정안전부령 제1호, 2017. 7. 26.> (행정안전부와 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of the Interior and Safety Decree No. 1, July 26, 2017> (Enforcement Rule on the Organization of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and its Affiliated Agencies)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Articles 2  through 7 omitted
Article 8 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① through <61> Omitted

rows.source_ko: <62> 저수지ㆍ댐의 안전관리 및 재해예방에 관한 법률 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: <62> The Enforcement Rules of the Act on Safety Management and Disaster Prevention of Reservoirs and Dams are partially amended as follows.
In Article 2, “Minister of Public Safety and Security” shall be changed to “Minister of the Interior and Safety.”

rows.source_ko: 별지 제3호서식 뒤쪽 처리절차란 중 “국민안전처”를 각각 “행정안전부”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the processing procedure section on the back of Form No. 3, “Ministry of Public Safety and Security” shall be changed to “Ministry of the Interior and Safety”.
<63> and <64> omitted

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <행정안전부령 제274호, 2021. 9. 7.> (어려운 법령용어 정비를 위한 29개 법령의 일부개정에 관한 행정안전부령)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of the Interior and Safety Decree No. 274, Sep. 7, 2021> (Ministry of the Interior and Safety Decree on the Partial Amendment of 29 Laws for the Reorganization of Difficult Legal Terms)
